stored_forms_all: Ti ratarak•akitah•ku Pari tuh•raru kskitiiks akitaru', he hiri we tahrak•ut; Tsawii, Kitkahahki, Pitahawirata, a Tskiri. Hiri wi•tuks•it•at akarraratau t'eks•kurit Kits Katus.
rows.gloss_stored: This our Pawnee tribe is made up of four bands; we are these: Tsawii, Kitkahahki, Pitahawirata and Tskiri. And it (the tribe) used to live, it is said, in mud lodges near the Platte ("Flat") River.

rows.gloss_stored: Twice a year they went hunting. It is said that they killed buffalo and deer, (game). In addition, they planted various things, corn, beans and squash. They would roast corn, and used to make jerky and they dried the beans and squash.
